description: Build a gasless CoW Protocol limit order (sell an ERC-20 for at least a target amount, valid until expiry). Returns EIP-712 typed data for the user's wallet to sign, the ERC-20 approve tx for CoW's vault relayer if the allowance is short, the current market amount for reference, and how to submit the signature. Never signs or submits. Result includes `display` markdown with chan images: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

buyAmount.description: Minimum human amount to receive (the limit). Provide this OR limitPrice.

chainId.description: Chain id where CoW runs: 1 Ethereum, 8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 137 Polygon, 56 BNB, 43114 Avalanche, 59144 Linea

limitPrice.description: Price in buyToken per 1 sellToken. Provide this OR buyAmount.

owner.description: Wallet that signs and owns the order

sellToken.description: ERC-20 to sell (not the native token; wrap first)

name: build_limit_order
title: Build a limit order
